tasks.label: build-current-file
tasks.command: REL_DIR=$(cygpath -m '${relativeFileDirname}'); REL_DIR=${REL_DIR#src/}; FILE=$(cygpath -m '${file}'); OUT_DIR="bin/$REL_DIR"; EXE="$OUT_DIR/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"; PCH="bin/_pch/bits/stdc++.h.gch"; if [ ! -f "$PCH" ]; then mkdir -p bin/_pch/bits && printf '#pragma once\n#include_next <bits/stdc++.h>\n' > bin/_pch/bits/stdc++.h && g++ -std=c++20 -g -O0 -Wall -x c++-header bin/_pch/bits/stdc++.h -o "$PCH"; fi; mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR" bin/_debug && if [ ! -f "$EXE" ] || [ "$FILE" -nt "$EXE" ]; then g++ -Ibin/_pch -std=c++20 -g -O0 -Wall "$FILE" -o "$EXE" || exit 1; fi && cp "$EXE" bin/_debug/debug.exe

tasks.label: run-current-file
tasks.command: REL_DIR=$(cygpath -m '${relativeFileDirname}'); REL_DIR=${REL_DIR#src/}; FILE=$(cygpath -m '${file}'); OUT_DIR="bin/$REL_DIR"; EXE="$OUT_DIR/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"; PCH="bin/_pch/bits/stdc++.h.gch"; if [ ! -f "$PCH" ]; then mkdir -p bin/_pch/bits && printf '#pragma once\n#include_next <bits/stdc++.h>\n' > bin/_pch/bits/stdc++.h && g++ -std=c++20 -g -O0 -Wall -x c++-header bin/_pch/bits/stdc++.h -o "$PCH"; fi; mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR" && if [ ! -f "$EXE" ] || [ "$FILE" -nt "$EXE" ]; then g++ -Ibin/_pch -std=c++20 -g -O0 -Wall "$FILE" -o "$EXE" || exit 1; fi && "$EXE"
